decisions.label: Methylated DNA Immunoprecipitation Sequencing
decisions.description: A library selection method using an antibody that specifically recognizes 5-methylcytidine to immunoprecipitate methylated DNA fragments, enriching for methylated genomic regions.

verification.note: NCIT:C204821 Methylated DNA Immunoprecipitation Sequencing (MeDIP-Seq); the selection method (anti-5mC antibody enrichment) is the same as MeDIP. NCIT frames it as the full sequencing procedure rather than just the selection step.

decisions.label: Oligo-dT Primer
decisions.description: A library selection method using oligo-dT primers to select for polyadenylated mRNA during cDNA synthesis, enriching for mature eukaryotic transcripts.

verification.note: NCIT:C201929 Oligo-dT Primer; the selection method uses oligo-dT to capture poly(A)+ RNA. The NCIT term describes the primer itself rather than the selection workflow; concept is directly relevant.

decisions.label: Random Primer
decisions.description: A library selection method using random-sequence oligonucleotides to prime cDNA synthesis, allowing unbiased coverage of RNA transcripts including non-polyadenylated species.

verification.note: NCIT:C201930 Random Primer; cDNA random priming uses random hexamers for priming. The NCIT term describes the primer type itself rather than the selection method; concept is directly relevant.

decisions.label: Oligo-dT Primer
decisions.description: A library selection method using poly-T (oligo-dT) oligonucleotides to capture polyadenylated mRNA, enriching for mature eukaryotic transcripts with poly(A) tails.

verification.note: NCIT:C201929 Oligo-dT Primer; Poly-T Enrichment describes bead-based poly-T capture of poly(A)+ RNA, the same molecular principle as oligo-dT priming. The NCIT term describes the primer/probe type; no dedicated 'poly-T enrichment' NCIT class exists.

decisions.label: Chromatin Immunoprecipitation
decisions.description: A molecular biology technique that uses antibodies to selectively enrich for specific protein-bound DNA fragments from cross-linked chromatin, allowing identification of genomic regions associated with specific proteins.

verification.note: NCIT:C106048 Chromatin Immunoprecipitation; confirmed as direct parent of ChIP-Seq (NCIT:C106049) in OLS search; exact concept match for ChIP as a library selection method.

decisions.label: Not Applicable
decisions.description: Determination of a value is not relevant in the current context.

verification.note: NCIT:C48660 Not Applicable; standard NCIT general qualifier.

decisions.label: Whole Genome Amplification
decisions.description: Multiple displacement amplification (MDA), a library selection method that uses phi29 polymerase with random primers to amplify the entire genome from minute quantities of DNA.

verification.note: NCIT:C19590 Whole Genome Amplification; MDA (Multiple Displacement Amplification) is a specific whole genome amplification technique. NCIT:C19590 is the parent class; no dedicated MDA subclass found in NCIT.

decisions.label: Oligo-dT Primer
decisions.description: DNA primers consisting of 12-18 deoxythymidines that anneal to the poly(A) tails of eukaryotic mRNAs, used to select for and prime reverse transcription of polyadenylated transcripts.

verification.note: NCIT:C201929 Oligo-dT Primer; exact label match (case-insensitive); used in rtPrimer and librarySelection context with the same concept.

decisions.label: Other
decisions.description: Different than the one(s) previously specified or mentioned.

verification.note: NCIT:C17649 Other; standard NCIT general qualifier.

decisions.label: Polymerase Chain Reaction
decisions.description: A method for amplifying a DNA base sequence using multiple rounds of heat denaturation and annealing of oligonucleotide primers in the presence of a heat-stable polymerase, used as a library selection strategy to amplify target sequences.

verification.note: NCIT:C17003 Polymerase Chain Reaction; confirmed as direct ancestor of RT-PCR and Real-Time PCR in OLS search; exact concept match for PCR as a library selection method.

decisions.label: Rapid Amplification of cDNA Ends
decisions.description: A molecular technique used to determine the 5' or 3' ends of mRNA transcripts by reverse transcription followed by PCR amplification of regions between a known internal sequence and the unknown transcript end.

verification.note: NCIT:C180698 Rapid Amplification of cDNA Ends; exact concept match; RACE is the common abbreviation for this method.

decisions.label: Random Primer
decisions.description: Short oligonucleotides of random sequence that anneal throughout RNA or DNA templates and are used to prime reverse transcription or amplification without sequence bias.

verification.note: NCIT:C201930 Random Primer; exact concept match for random priming as a library selection strategy.

decisions.label: Polymerase Chain Reaction
decisions.description: PCR amplification using random primers to generate unbiased amplification of genomic DNA or cDNA without requiring prior knowledge of target sequences.

verification.note: NCIT:C17003 Polymerase Chain Reaction; Random PCR uses random primers for amplification. No dedicated NCIT class for random-primer PCR; the generic PCR class (C17003) is the closest match.

decisions.label: Reduced-Representation Bisulfite Sequencing
decisions.description: A library selection method that uses restriction enzymes to reduce genome complexity by enriching for CpG-dense restriction fragments before bisulfite conversion and sequencing.

verification.note: NCIT:C167284 Reduced-Representation Bisulfite Sequencing (RRBS); the NCIT term describes the complete method (selection + bisulfite + sequencing), while 'Reduced Representation' as a library selection refers only to the size-selection/restriction step. No generic 'Reduced Representation' class found in NCIT.

decisions.label: Reverse Transcriptase-Polymerase Chain Reaction
decisions.description: A laboratory procedure in which an RNA strand is first reverse-transcribed into a complementary DNA strand, which is then amplified by PCR; used as a library selection strategy for RNA-derived libraries.

verification.note: NCIT:C18136 Reverse Transcriptase-Polymerase Chain Reaction; confirmed in OLS search as direct parent of qRT-PCR; exact concept match for RT-PCR.
NCIT:C38046 Unspecified; standard NCIT general qualifier.
